name: NIIME — Molecular Electronics Research Institute
desc: Network infrastructure modernization for a microelectronics R&D environment. Replacement and construction of structured cabling across an 18-storey building, with an optical backbone and a network rack on every floor. Separate IT and security server rooms and a restricted-access technical space.

name: Mikron — 90 nm Production
desc: Physical network and connectivity work supporting a 90 nm semiconductor production environment. Structured cabling across buildings 1–4, fibre connectivity to every floor, and industrial-network integration in a high-availability setting.

name: Mikron — 180 nm Production
desc: Separate 180 nm manufacturing infrastructure scope within the Mikron site. Structured copper and fibre cabling across production buildings 1–4, inter-floor links and support for industrial networking and building technical systems.

name: Mikron — 45 nm Laboratory
desc: Dedicated laboratory infrastructure work associated with the 45 nm research area, including technical connectivity and uninterruptible power supply (UPS) infrastructure. This describes the laboratory support scope, not a claim of commercial 45 nm production.

name: MRTZ — Laboratory Building
desc: Structured cabling and fibre-optic infrastructure for a laboratory building at the Moscow Radio Engineering Plant (MRTZ), with UPS-related power continuity systems and technical network infrastructure.

name: Nauka-Svyaz — Metro Fibre Network
desc: Fibre-optic telecommunications infrastructure work across Moscow and Moscow Oblast for Nauka-Svyaz, an operator with its own metropolitan and regional optical network.

name: MC NTT — Moscow Optical Network
desc: City-wide optical network work in Moscow for the Moscow Centre for New Telecommunications Technologies (MC NTT). The stated project scope covered approximately 600 fibre-optic cables.

name: MGTS — Multi-pair Telephone Network
desc: Work on approximately 200 multi-pair telecommunications cables in the Moscow fixed-line network, including copper distribution, cable connectivity and infrastructure modernization.

name: MTS — Fibre & Mobile Base Stations
desc: Fibre-optic network and connectivity work related to MTS mobile base-station sites. Optical access infrastructure, physical connections and network installation support.

name: Beeline — Fibre & Mobile Base Stations
desc: Optical infrastructure and connectivity work for Beeline base-station facilities, including fibre connections, physical network equipment and technical installation support.

name: Donatos — Video Conferencing & SCS
desc: Office structured cabling and a video conferencing system for approximately 50 employees. Connectivity for conference rooms, network endpoints, audiovisual communication and supporting low-voltage systems.

name: Columbus — Shopping Centre Cabling
desc: Structured cabling works within the Columbus shopping and entertainment centre in Moscow. Network cable routing, connection points and support for retail-building connectivity systems.

name: Vremena Goda — Retail Galleries
desc: Structured cabling work at Vremena Goda, a premium shopping gallery complex on Kutuzovsky Prospekt in Moscow. Physical network and low-voltage connectivity for a multi-tenant retail environment.

name: Technopark Obninsk TECH
desc: Communication networks and server-room infrastructure for a technology hub: racks and equipment spaces, virtualization and backup architecture, security infrastructure, testing, technical documentation and operational handover.

name: Hyatt Sochi — Hotel Communications
desc: On-site network and low-voltage communications infrastructure deployment for a hotel environment. Equipment installation, connectivity testing, commissioning support and technical coordination.
